thread:
mohit: Quick onboarding check for the llama3-13b-fp16 weights. Where are the canonical weights and tokenizer files? Seeing weird BOS/id behavior in a few prompts, and want to confirm RoPE scaling + attention packing for runtime.
anya: We put the latest snapshot in s3://redwood-models/llama3/13b/fp16/weights-2026-02-10/. There's a tokenizer/ subfolder + tokenizer_config.json. @mohit FYI.
zach: heads-up: tokenizer was exported with HF fast-tokenizers v0.15 — BOS was set to id 1 in their export. Our loader expects 0 by default. See `tokenizer_config.json` in the folder.
jin: Runtime note: this model expects RoPE scaling. Our rotary impl supports dynamic scaling but config must include `rope_scaling`. If absent we use base 10000 which will cause mismatch for long-context tests.
cameron: Also the weights metadata has `attention_type: "gqa"` and `heads_per_group: 8`. Loader needs to detect GQA vs MQA and reshape Q/K accordingly.
mohit: Action items: 1) @anya please add a short README in the S3 path called "runtime_notes.md" with explicit BOS id and tokenizer version. 2) @jin add a linter rule so model config without `rope_scaling` fails validation. 3) @zach add a loader warning when attention_type != runtime default. I'll run a local smoke test after these.
deploy-bot: :gear: queued deploy job `runtime-check-llama3-13b` to eng-runtime-staging (job id: 2026-03-21_042)
zach: Quick repro: with a ~9k token prompt we saw token drift if sliding_window isn't enabled. Sliding window setting currently is `sliding_window: true` with `window_size: 4096`. Without it, RoPE phase wrap causes generation artifacts.
anya: I'll export a tokenizer shim that maps BOS id 1 -> 0 and add `add_prefix_space: true` flag if needed. Will also upload `tokenizer_compat.json` in the folder.
jin: I'll add unit tests in `eng-runtime/tests/test_rope_scaling.py` and a config linter rule. Proposed config snippet for validator:
```
rope_scaling:
  type: dynamic
  interp: linear
  factor: 1.5
attention:
  type: gqa
  heads_per_group: 8
```
mohit: Also confirm quantization compatibility: prefer int4-gguf / q4_0 fallback. If loader sees `gguf_quant: q4_1` but kernel missing, we should fail-fast with clear msg rather than silent degrade.
cameron: Note on KV cache: MQA/GQA packing changes KV shape. Loader must check `kv_pack: "mqa"/"gqa"/null` and reshape from [batch, seq, heads*head_dim] -> expected internal layout. Failing to reshape leads to subtle alignment bugs.
zach: Will add a debug mode that prints kv shapes at runtime for the first forward and a one-off check in the smoke test harness.
mohit: Perfect — once PRs for tokenizer shim + linter + loader warnings are up, ping me and I'll run the staging job. Thanks team :rocket:
